visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men stand on a large stage. The man on the left wears an oversized light blue striped shirt and grey trousers, holding a microphone. The man on the right wears a beige blazer and dark jeans. The background is a large screen with a bright, pink-to-white gradient. (2) The scene shifts to a wider shot of the stage. The two men are joined by an older man in a suit and a woman. They stand in front of a giant green screen displaying Chinese text. They perform a 'heart' gesture with their arms. (3) The camera pans across a seated audience in a large, dark, industrial-style hall. People are wearing masks and watching the stage. (4) The man in the blue shirt is seen laughing and gesturing wildly with his hands while interacting with the man in the beige blazer. (5) A close-up interview shot shows the two men standing together, surrounded by several microphones from different news outlets like 'ETtoday' and 'SET'. (6) The man in the blue shirt is seen alone in a small dressing room area with wooden cabinets, laughing heartily while holding a card. (7) Back on the main stage, the two men continue their animated conversation, with the man in the beige blazer laughing and leaning forward. (8) The video ends with a wide shot of the entire stage area, showing multiple cameras and crew members filming the event.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic BGM starts immediately. A young man's energetic voice narrates, speaking rapidly with a cheerful tone. (2) A loud 'whoosh' SFX triggers at a visual transition, accompanied by a slight swell in music volume. (3) A cartoon 'pop' sound effect occurs as text bubbles appear visually. (4) A laugh track and real laughter from the stage participants overlap as the speakers make a joke. (5) A sharp 'ding' sound effect punctuates a funny realization in the speech. (6) The audio transitions to a more direct interview recording style with audible room tone, though the BGM continues to play softly in the background. (7) A comedic 'slide' sound effect plays during a fast visual montage. (8) The video concludes with the BGM reaching its finale, ending with a clean fade-out of both speech and music.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Event Highlights -> Promotional CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the new reality TV show '戀愛，重修中' (Love, Retake) produced by SET and Shih Hsin University. The video uses highlights from a press conference to showcase the humorous chemistry between the hosts and generate interest in the show's premiere.
